audience: shipping teams with authorized Shipcloud API access

useCases.title: Track recent deliveries
useCases.text: Read recent shipments and inspect tracking for selected parcels.

useCases.title: Check a shipping price
useCases.text: Get a quote before deciding whether to buy a label. Carrier contracts and vendor charges apply.

useCases.title: Prepare an agreed shipment
useCases.text: Save a shipment without buying its shipping label.

useCases.title: Buy an approved label
useCases.text: After reviewing the price and recipient, buy a label only with explicit confirmation. Check Shipcloud before repeating an uncertain result.

useCases.title: Request an agreed carrier pickup
useCases.text: Request a pickup only with explicit confirmation. The carrier may charge and these tools cannot cancel the pickup.
